resources.string: Trakt needs an application of your own. Sign in at trakt.tv, open trakt.tv/oauth/applications, choose New Application, enter any name and the redirect address urn:ietf:wg:oauth:2.0:oob, save it, and enter its client id and client secret here.
While scrobbling is on, the titles of the movies and episodes you watch, and how far you got, are sent to Trakt. Only videos recognised as a movie or an episode are sent.
Waiting until you enter the code at %1$s…
